text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, all these side dishes look 
delicious! Alright, time for another bowl 
of rice—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, this fits my exact calorie count...! 
And I've got plenty of protein, too!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... That's amazing, Tsuro-chan! You're 
writing down everything you eat!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yep! I have voluntary training after this. 
You know that upcoming fan event? I'm 
getting ready for it—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
You know how I often fall ill and end up 
missing out on races and events?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Watching everyone shine out on the 
racetrack and the stage from the audience 
stands... it always frustrated me so much—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
But lately, I've been feeling great! So 
I'm being super careful to make sure I 
maintain this peak condition—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Whether it's my meals or my workouts, I'm 
giving it my all! Because after so long 
away, I want to show everyone my absolute 
best!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
............ ...Tsuro-chan, I won't have 
seconds after all.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Eh...!? Why not?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Because I want to put on the best stage 
together with you, Tsuro-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It's settled! Until the live concert, I'm 
eating the same meals as you, and joining 
in on your voluntary training too!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I think it'll be way more motivating for 
you if there are two of us! What do you 
say...!?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan...! Thank you! Let's do our best 
together until the concert!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... Tsuro-chan, can you 
still keep going...?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*, *gasp*... Yeah...! I have 
to build more stamina so I can dance 
through the final Umapyoi properly!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
You're right...! Let's do one more round! 
I won't lose either...!

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Lady
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, Spe-chan, is that all you're 
having? You're not having the special menu 
zangi fried chicken?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, just this for today... ...Piping 
hot rice and fried chicken... Uuuu...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
S-Spe-chan, are you okay...? You really 
don't have to push yourself so hard just 
for me...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
No, this is for my own sake too. Lately, 
my legs have felt a bit heavy... I need to 
trim down and get into top form...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
One, two, three, four! One, two, three, 
four!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Tsuro-chan, that looks really 
great! You seem to be in fantastic 
shape...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... It might be the first time in a 
while that I've felt this great right 
before a live event...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm in top condition too! I managed to 
drop down to my ideal race weight! 
Tsuro-chan, let's make this the best stage 
ever!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I went to observe the fan event 
where the Golden Generation was gathered. 
The ones receiving the loudest cheers 
were—

text_block_list.name: Audience Member A
text_block_list.text:
Tsuro-chan is full of energy today! And 
Spe-chan's dancing is so sharp and 
amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Audience Member B
text_block_list.text:
Looking good, you twoooo!! You're the 
absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi danced with vibrant 
energy, while Special Week captivated the 
crowd with her sharp movements. Thanks to 
both of them, the live concert was a 
tremendous success.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
We did it, Tsuro-chan...! That was the 
absolute best...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...! We gave it our all right till the 
very end...! It's all because you were 
right there beside me, Spe-chan!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
You're always so straightforward and 
devoted— Seeing that made me want to give 
it my all too!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Spe-chan, I hope you'll always stay 
just the way you are now...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I want you to always be my goal and my 
rival! Not just on stage, but out on the 
racetrack too!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Next time is the races! Let's both 
be in our best condition and put on an 
incredible showdown...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm getting all fired up! Tsuro-chan, 
let's do a tandem training run together 
tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, let's do it, let's do it! I've gotta 
make sure my body is fully prepared...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Precious comrades, and rivals who push 
each other forward— The bond between the 
two of them was truly wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm getting so pumped up! Tsuro-chan, 
starting tomorrow, let's keep having the 
same meals—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*groooowwwl*)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, Spe-chan, let's have an 
after-party right now! I want you to eat 
until you're completely full today!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Y-You're right, ehehe... I'm gonna get 
tons of second helpings...!
